research_notes: Canikli Ali Paşa became Kars serasker only in December 1776, too late for the start date.

name_variants: Timur Shah Durrani; Taimur Shah Durrani; Timur Shah Sadōzay/Sadozai
exact_military_function: Supreme dynastic military authority over the Durrani realm; organizer of the central royal military base after transfer of the capital to Kabul, not commander of a permanent numbered corps
command_start: 1772 (accession); capital and military power base shifted to Kabul in 1775
social_political_profile: Sadozai royal tribal aristocracy; reduced dependence on Pashtun tribal chiefs by relying more on urban Persianized Tajik/Qizilbash elements and royal troops
portrait_or_contemporary_description: Period portrait tradition exists, but no securely authenticated exact 1776 likeness was validated in this audit
existing_historical_character: YES — existing DUR historical ruler Timur Shah Durrani
existing_dna_or_template: No explicit Timur DNA/template found in the audited 1776 ruler definition
decision_rationale: Use only as HIGHER_COMMAND_ABSTRACTION for the main DUR formation. The Durrani army was a composite of tribal contingents and royal troops rather than two standing V3 corps; Timur was the sovereign military authority, and the main formation represents that realm-wide force. Do not duplicate him onto the second Balkh formation.
source_1: Encyclopaedia Iranica, AFGHANISTAN x. Political History: https://www.iranicaonline.org/articles/afghanistan-x-political-history/
